all_required_checks_summary: All 849 candidate reason sequences, all 103 file-scan pagination/stats records and 258 changed-file entries, all repository qualifier/first-selection lists, complete five-member fixed-order pool, all 132 ledger endpoints/projections/statuses/counts and supported cost/digest arithmetic agree with independently recomputed expectations.
coverage_equation: 9 closed-PR list calls + 103 changed-file page calls + 10 commit metadata calls + 10 tree metadata calls = 132 retained metadata API calls.

ledger_and_costs.screening_cost_limit: No screening output was inspected, so actual admission/native screening cost cannot be audited here.
ledger_and_costs.timing_interpretation: Sum of recorded call durations is not expected to equal elapsed metadata time because up to three repository scanners overlap. Wall time and timestamps are retained values; only their internal consistency and budget arithmetic are checked. Zero native/collection calls are reported metadata values and agree with permitted endpoint classes, not proof of no unlogged activity.

predicate_application: Original v2 scan reasons in fixed sequence; v3 production-status filter applied only to candidates without original v2 rejection reasons; selections take first final qualifier in retained returned order.

retained_timestamp_order_anomalies.interpretation: Retained PR order is not strictly descending by retained updated_at. Endpoint parameters match the fixed request, and selection correctly uses retained returned order. The frozen rules require first eligibility in returned order, with no post-query sorting or monotonicity rejection requirement. These copied records do not independently authenticate GitHub response chronology or globally latest-100 membership; no cause is inferred.

scope.claim_boundary: Findings establish internal consistency of retained committed metadata and ledgers. No independently observed network traffic, response provenance/completeness, absence of unlogged calls, real-world prior exposure, Git commitment history, or native/admission outcomes is established. V4 curator code is not among this subaudit inputs, so its runtime behavior/code digest is not independently checked.
scope.freshness_and_order_limit: Requested sort=updated&direction=desc and fixed one-page query semantics are verified from retained ledger entries; selection by retained returned order is independently reproduced. Actual globally latest 100 PRs, complete original responses and GitHub response chronology are not independently authenticated. Three retained repositories show timestamp inversions, preserved in this report without rewriting candidate order.
scope.method: Stdlib byte reads, JSON/AST parsing and independent predicate/order/accounting reimplementation only; copied helper code was never executed or imported. No Git, network/API query, task-source read or screening-output read.
